title: Bigger pack reveals on phones
items: Opening a pack on a phone uses the leftover screen for the card instead of squeezing it between the title, thumbs, and buttons.
Rarity stamps are off unless you turn them on in Settings.

title: Phones can actually rip packs now
items: The layout fits a phone instead of sitting zoomed in and clipped.
Cards tilt under your finger, not only a mouse.
Opening a pack no longer lets the page scroll through the overlay — Leave pack and Done stay on screen.
